data_supply.action: Expand and audit task inputs before outcome collection for the balanced design. Unequal weighting requires a separately frozen estimand and recalculated precision; do not silently concentrate on convenient sites.
data_supply.equal_site_bottleneck: 95 families at the smallest site minus4 pilot minus30 online leaves61 stage2 attempts per site.
data_supply.unused_caveat: Unused by old confidence study, not certified model-training-unseen.

estimators.D: mean of three (Piotr minus first) binary-outcome differences within a state
estimators.q: mean(g) on the eligible heldout cohort
estimators.uncertainty: Resample entire task families within declared site strata, all repeats together; recompute q inside each bootstrap. Coherent prespecified weights must be used throughout.

fitting.adaptation: Any fit expansion and exact budget are decided using fitting evidence only before heldout outcomes are opened; heldout sizing may use conservatively bounded fit-based nuisance variance, not heldout effect-driven stopping.
fitting.criteria: Fit-only nested task-family learning curves and bootstrap selection/expansion stability; keep model/grid small and frozen before collection. Stable always/never rules are allowed.
fitting.learning_curve_scope: Fractions of each outer fold training pool, never fractions of heldout evaluation. Report OOF paired utility uncertainty and expansion rate; split site/depth diagnostics.
fitting.limitation: No universal guarantee that a finite threshold is learnable from any chosen N.
fitting.provisional_allocation: Match the heldout usable-state target for planning; this is not a power-derived fitting minimum.

gate_features: Only first-response features available before additional candidates are sampled.

power.interpretation: Conditional on the trained/frozen gate achieving the stated gain in BOTH contrasts and each state-level contrast variance respecting its planning scenario; not probability of learning a beneficial rule.
power.method: Noncentral-t planning proxy, df=n-1; approximate for bounded outcomes and nonlinear matched-random contrast. No finite-sample guarantee.
power.repeats: Three repeats do not triple independent states. For averaged exchangeable repeat contrasts only, V=single_repeat_variance*(1+2*rho)/3. Not a derivation of matched-random influence variance.
power.variance: Variance of each final state-level contrast/influence function, not automatically Var(Piotr-first). Gate frequency estimated on heldout is accounted for.

resources.budget_status: Requires measured startup, prefix, selector, suffix, judge and cleanup throughput/receipts. Cannot infer GPU-hours or USD from this offline power analysis.
resources.online_validation: Old240-task reserve is bookkeeping only; final every-step study needs its own power analysis and resource approval.
resources.outcome_count_caveat: Target endpoints are for resolved target states only; issued/failed endpoints, retries and startup count in the separately approved cap.
resources.pilot: Unchanged prepared1 H200/16CPU/240GiB x2h all-attempt cap; exact approval still absent;0 selector/judge/API spend.

scope: One intervention per replay-eligible state; fixed represented sites. No every-step or unseen-site claim.
supersedes: 240 attempted fit tasks +240 attempted heldout tasks; not a cap

task_collection.inflation: Expected-only n/y is not a high-probability guarantee. Provision table uses per-split P(Binomial(A,y)>=n)>=.975, hence>=.95 jointly by union bound under the iid yield model. Heterogeneous site failures can invalidate this approximation.
task_collection.missing: Keep pre-action failures and released missing endpoints distinct and visible. Never impute or relabel missing evidence. Falling below usable target reduces precision; it does not authorize a retry or replacement.
task_collection.resolution_yield: Full six-endpoint resolution yield; a pre-action-only replay pass fraction cannot estimate it.
task_collection.stopping: Freeze task manifest, attempt caps and admission rules before outcomes; complete all planned dispositions. No outcome-dependent replacement or stop-on-significance.
task_collection.target_unit: Distinct task-family state with all prespecified repeated endpoints resolved

checks: single-primary V=.5, delta=.1 requires395 under noncentral-t
